summary: Bionano Genomics filed an 8-K on May 5, 2026, reporting the immediate termination of President and CEO R. Erik Holmlin, Ph.D., who resigned from the board. The board appointed Chairman Albert A. Luderer, Ph.D., age 77, as Interim CEO and interim principal financial officer. Dr. Luderer stepped down from board committees but remains Chairman. The company expects Dr. Holmlin to enter a consulting agreement for transition. A search for a permanent CEO will commence. Severance will follow the employment agreement subject to a release. No financial terms or advisor named. Watch for the permanent CEO appointment.
